summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-Rex 2X Long Microsoft Daily Target ETF (MSFX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Microsoft Corp. stock, less fees, and expenses. MSFX was launched on Jan 11, 2024 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
